[p]Hello everyone!
I’m excited to share that the official DOSMIC Discord server is now open. 🎉[/p][p]This will be the best place to:[/p][list][*][p]Get the latest updates on DOSMIC[/p][/*][*][p]Share your feedback and suggestions[/p][/*][*][p]Connect with other players and fans[/p][/*][/list][p]👉 Join here: [url="https://discord.gg/yH7t6CDc8e"]https://discord.gg/yH7t6CDc8e[/url][/p][p]I’d love to see you there and hear your thoughts as we continue developing the game together.[/p][p]Thank you for your support![/p]

notes.title: 🎮 DOSMIC Demo Now Available on Steam
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,
I'm the solo developer behind [b]DOSMIC[/b], and today I'm excited (and a little nervous) to announce that the demo version is now officially available on Steam.[/p][previewyoutube="N9aj5l5QlZc;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Though it's still a short and early look into the world I'm building, this demo represents the very first step of the journey I want to share with you.[/p][p][b]DOSMIC[/b] is a cinematic adventure game about a boy who has lost someone precious to him.
Alone, he ventures through a collapsing world ruled by massive, unknowable beings, all in search of the missing girl.
This demo captures the beginning of that journey.[/p][p]As a solo developer, there are still rough edges and many things I plan to improve.
But I truly believe in this project, and I’m committed to making it better, step by step.
If you give the demo a try and have any thoughts, big or small, I’d be deeply grateful to hear them.[/p][p]Thank you so much for playing.
I’ll continue to share updates as development progresses.[/p][p]— Black Cheeze[/p]

notes.title: DOSMIC Demo Coming Soon During BIG Fall Showcase! ✨
notes.content: [p][b]Hello everyone,[/b][/p][p]This is Black Cheeze, the solo developer behind [i]DOSMIC[/i].[/p][p] I am very excited to greet you here on the Steam Community page for the first time.[/p][p]I am developing this game alone, with the belief that even in the darkest moments, a small spark of hope can still exist. Through [i]DOSMIC[/i], I want to deliver that feeling to players by telling the journey of a boy who continues forward despite despair and darkness.[/p][p]The new demo build of [i]DOSMIC[/i] is currently under Steam review, and I am preparing to release it during the ongoing [b]BIG Fall Showcase event[/b].[/p][p]I will continue to share updates and progress here in this community. I sincerely hope the journey of [i]DOSMIC[/i] will become a special experience for you, and I would be grateful if you stay with me until the end.[/p][p]If you are interested in this journey, please consider adding [i]DOSMIC[/i] to your wishlist. Your support means a lot and will help bring the game to more players around the world.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3450900/DOSMIC/"][/dynamiclink]Thank you.[/p][p][b]Youngsoo Kim (Black Cheeze)[/b][/p]
